sources.name: Forecast tiles
sources.notes: The tile service combines several upstream models; each one's terms are in the vendored forecast-tiles register (contracts/forecast-tiles-data-sources.json). Nothing is recorded for the service as a whole. Terms not yet confirmed.

sources.name: ECMWF open data for synoptic charts
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use for open data
sources.attribution: This service is based on data and products of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0 plus ECMWF's Terms of Use for open data. For a service built on the data, the credit is "This service is based on data and products of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)", shown prominently with the source, the licence link, ECMWF's disclaimer and a statement that the data were modified; ECMWF may ask for the credit to be removed. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine currents
sources.attribution: Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information
sources.notes: Derived works may be distributed for any purpose with the credit "Generated using E.U. Copernicus Marine Service Information" and each product's DOI, placed on the home page or the page where users get the data. The licence asks licensees to keep records that trace product use, and that duty passes into every downstream licence; it carries an indemnity, is under French law, has no version number and can be revised at any time. Downloads need a personal login; no page says any product can be downloaded without one. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: ERA5 reanalysis
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0 replaced the older Copernicus licence on 2 July 2025. Credit is the dataset's own citation with DOI 10.24381/cds.adbb2d47 (the older "Copernicus Climate Change Service information" sentence belongs to the previous licence); downloads need a Climate Data Store account. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Météo-France marine bulletins
sources.notes: Licence Ouverte 2.0 on the government portal's dataset page, which is the dataset warnings_mf.py reads. Credit Météo-France and the date of last update, and imply no endorsement. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Met Office shipping forecast print page
sources.notes: The owner states an arrangement with the provider that covers Passage's use (stated 2026-11-12). Its terms are not recorded in this repository. The provider's public terms, as read on 2026-11-12, would not by themselves allow it.

sources.name: NWS marine alerts (api.weather.gov)
sources.licence: Open data, free for any purpose (NWS API documentation)
sources.notes: Requests must send a User-Agent that identifies the application, and unpublished rate limits apply. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Meteoalarm warnings
sources.licence: MeteoAlarm Terms and Conditions (equivalent to CC BY 4.0, with added requirements)
sources.notes: The terms add seven requirements to CC BY 4.0, among them naming the source, showing the issue time, linking to meteoalarm.org, publishing a set disclaimer, showing modified information with the unmodified, and real-time redistribution; whether saved briefings meet the real-time one is open. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: BOM marine wind warnings
sources.notes: The owner states an arrangement with the provider that covers Passage's use (stated 2026-11-12). Its terms are not recorded in this repository. The provider's public terms, as read on 2026-11-12, would not by themselves allow it.

sources.name: NOAA CO-OPS tide predictions
sources.notes: Credit is requested; the data are provided as is, and modified data must not be shown as official. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Maritime Safety Queensland tide predictions
sources.notes: Credit the State of Queensland (Transport and Main Roads, Maritime Safety Queensland), link the licence and note changes. Two of the four prediction datasets were checked, and one near-real-time dataset shows CC BY 3.0. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: NDBC realtime observations
sources.licence: Public domain (NDBC, US Government work); the two buoys read are owned by the UK Met Office
sources.notes: NDBC states no terms for data it relays, and the Met Office's terms for these observations were not read. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Copernicus In Situ TAC moorings
sources.notes: The product's user manual, where contributor conditions would be, was not read, and the Copernicus Marine record-keeping clause applies. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: Queensland Coastal Data System wave buoys
sources.notes: Credit the Queensland Government; the Gladstone buoy is run jointly with Gladstone Ports Corporation. Only the Gladstone record was read. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: World Port Index (Publication 150)
sources.notes: NGA's own pages could not be read, and the bundled copy came through a third-party portal. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap base map tiles
sources.licence: OpenStreetMap tile usage policy; map data ODbL 1.0
sources.notes: Passage displays the tiles and does not redistribute them; the policy forbids bulk download and requires visible credit, and commercial services are warned that access can be withdrawn. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.

sources.name: OpenSeaMap seamark tiles
sources.notes: Displayed as an overlay; the tile licence version (2.0) rests on a search summary, and no tile usage policy was found. Confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-12.
